title_sq: Tek Komuna E Parisit , Shitet Apartament 2+1 Totalisht I Investuar!!
description_sq: Tek Komuna E Parisit, Shitet Apartament 2+1 Totalisht I Investuar!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 2-te banim te nje pallati te ri te mireadministruar me ashensor dhe organizohet ne sallonin ndenjes me kendin e gatimit, dy dhomat e gjumit, te dyja me dalje ne ballkon dhe tualeti me dritare. Prona eshte totalisht e investuar dhe e mobiluar me arkitekt, eshte nje mundesi ideale si per banim edhe per investim, pasi zona ne te cilen ndodhet eshte nje nga zonat me te preferuara te Tiranes. Prona disponon dokumentacion te plote dhe te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: In the Municipality of Paris, 2+1 Apartment for Sale, Totally Invested!!
description_en: In the Municipality of Paris, 2+1 Apartment for Sale Fully Invested!! The apartment is located on the 2nd residential floor of a new well-managed building with an elevator and is organized in a living room with a kitchenette, two bedrooms, both with access to the balcony, and a bathroom with a window. The property is fully invested and furnished with an architect, it is an ideal opportunity for both residence and investment, as the area in which it is located is one of the most preferred areas of Tirana. The property has complete and regular mortgage documentation.
